title: Successor formula for pool code
statement: For every natural number $N$, the pool initialization code for $N+1$ entries is the pool initialization code for $N$ entries followed by the instruction that adds the constant one to the value at pool address $c_{\mathrm{Pool}}(N)$ and stores the result at $c_{\mathrm{Pool}}(N+1)$, where $c_{\mathrm{Pool}}(n)=-(25+4n)$.
